people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.
translations.bsb: Paul wanted to go before the assembly, but the disciples would not allow him.
translations.kjv: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
translations.asv: And when Paul was minded to enter in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
